Usage: agentcage cage backup [OPTIONS] NAME

  Create a backup tarball of a cage.

Options:
  -o, --output PATH  Output path (default: ./{name}-backup-{timestamp}.tar.gz)
  --include-secrets  Include secret values in the backup (handle with care)
  --no-color         Disable colored output.
  --quiet            Suppress progress output (spinners and banners).
  -h, --help         Show this message and exit.
